title: The Student Complaint and Appeals Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Real information from reliable public sources and official catalogs, fact-checked reference. Official grievance processes, appeal deadlines, and relevant policies. The Student Complaint and Appeals Database documents official grievance and appeal processes from published institutional policies: grade appeals, conduct appeals, discrimination complaints, and the deadlines that govern each. Records lay out each process as a step sequence with required forms. The Signature side adds timeline planners that count backward from deadlines.
capabilities: Document grievance and appeal processes as step sequences
Record deadlines and required forms per process type
Provide timeline planners counting back from deadlines
Link to the official policy text for each process
Distinguish informal resolution from formal appeals
